title: PreToolUse output
description: Allows, denies, asks, or corrects the tool call. Exit code 2 = deny. Zed reads deny/ask before validating updatedInput. Top level open for Claude Code compatibility (same reason as hookSpecificOutput): unknown fields are ignored.

decision.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1992). DEPRECATED legacy form: "block" means permissionDecision "deny", "approve" means "allow". Accepted for old scripts. When both this and permissionDecision are present, the most restrictive wins (deny > ask > allow): a denial always wins, wherever it comes from (Zed choice, not found in the source).

reason.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1992). DEPRECATED, goes with `decision`: same role as permissionDecisionReason.

hookSpecificOutput.description: Event-specific output. Open for Claude Code compatibility: Claude Code adds fields here across versions, and a script shared with Claude Code must not be rejected by Zed for a field Zed does not know. Unknown fields are ignored.

hookEventName.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1064). Must be this event name; in Zed a mismatch is a hook failure.

permissionDecision.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1965). "defer" is accepted and treated as no decision (Claude Code supports it only in -p mode).

permissionDecisionReason.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1966). For deny: sent to the model as the tool result. For allow/ask: shown to the user.

updatedInput.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1967). Replaces the whole input. null means absent. Open here because its shape depends on the tool; Zed reads deny/ask first, then validates it against tool-inputs.schema.json before running the tool, and treats a mismatch as a hook failure.

additionalContext.description: Claude Code field (sources/claude-code-2026-10-30.md:1305). Text added to the model context.
